name: folk
summary: Lightweight, collaborative CRM for managing contacts and relationships. Centralize your network and personalize outreach without the bloat. A mobile app (Contacts by folk) adds on-the-go search, one-tap contact capture with business-card scanning, voice notes and interaction tracking across WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email and calendar.
best_for: small sales teams, agencies and VC/partnership teams who want a clean, fast-to-set-up CRM with a great LinkedIn enrichment extension
skip_if: you need real multi-step workflow automation and reporting, or you are on Standard and want Zapier, Make or the REST API — folk keeps those for Premium and up, and is lightweight by design
honest_knock: One gap has closed and one has narrowed. folk now has a mobile app — the pricing table carries a Mobile app row ticked on all three plans — so the browser-only complaint is out of date. Automation is still uneven, but the picture moved in September: Zapier and Make stay Premium and Enterprise only, and so does the REST API, yet the table now carries an MCP row ticked on all three plans. Standard therefore does have a programmatic route — through an AI client rather than a workflow builder — and no plan shows a native multi-step workflow. Enrichment is capped at 500 a month on Standard and 1,000 on Premium, and email sequences need at least Premium.

pricing.notes: $30/member/month on Standard, $60 on Premium and from $100 on Enterprise when billed monthly; billed yearly those drop to $24, $48 and from $80 per member per month — 20% off — for $288, $576 and $960 per member per year (re-verified 2026-09-03; every figure held). The same page publishes euro rates: 27€, 54€ and from 83€ monthly, 22€, 43€ and from 67€ yearly, for 259€, 518€ and 804€ a year. The free trial is two weeks and needs no credit card; folk's own FAQ says an account that does not upgrade is blocked rather than deleted at the end, and that the trial can be extended by a week on request. The published caps: email enrichment 500 a month on Standard, 1,000 on Premium and custom on Enterprise; AI magic fields 2,000 and 5,000; account sync one per member and five per member.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 23 October 2026 during the 14-day Premium trial, without a card and without connecting any account, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, extension or desktop app: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We made a group with two made-up people, linked a deal to each with known values, checked the pipeline sum, added a note to a deal and exported the data.
findings: Onboarding took six screens and asked for no card; the last one said 'Welcome to your 14-day free trial' with access to all Premium features, and the app then showed 'Premium trial (2 weeks left)'. Skipping the account connection meant clicking 'No, I like endless copy-paste' and then confirming 'Continue with fewer features?'.
A new group immediately got the views All people and Pipeline. Create person (with 'Create more') added both test people in one go.

Adding a Deals column created a Deals tab as well. Typing a new deal in each person's cell created both deals, linked to the right person; values of 100 and 200 were kept, shown as $100 and $200 although we never picked a currency.
The deals pipeline showed both cards under 'No status'; switching the column calculation to Sum of Deal value gave $300, matching 100 + 200.

Adding a note to a deal failed twice: the first note was not saved (Notes 0), and the second attempt showed 'Whoops! An unexpected error occurred'. After Reload the note saved and the card showed a note icon.
not_tested: Connections with Google, Microsoft, WhatsApp or LinkedIn, and the Chrome extension
Enrichment, AI fields, assistants and email sequences
What remains on Standard after the 14 days (the pricing page lists Deals under Premium)
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.

claim_checks.claim: "No, we don't ask for your credit card during the trial." and "2 weeks free trial"
claim_checks.observed: Sign-up and onboarding asked for no card; the last screen said 'Welcome to your 14-day free trial ... access to all our Premium features' and the app showed 'Premium trial (2 weeks left)'.
claim_checks.comparability: Same quantity: trial length and card requirement at sign-up.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: You can try folk for two weeks without a card, but the trial runs on Premium features, so Deals and other Premium features you test may not be in a cheaper plan.

sessions.claim_checks_note: A vendor claim (quoted, with source and read date) set against what we observed in this session on the plan stated. status is confirmed, contradicted, not_comparable, not_testable or out_of_date; it is not a score of the product.

exit_test.what: On 23 October 2026, in the trial workspace from this test, we exported the Deals view and the People view with folk's own export and compared the files with what we had entered: two people, two deals linked to them with values 100 and 200, a group and one note on a deal. We did not re-import the files.
came_along: Both people and both deals, with the right values (100 and 200) and the linked person
The group (TESTHAVEN), in the people export
The note on the deal, in a separate notes.csv with deal ID, deal name and time
lost: The person-deal link as an ID: deals.csv names the person ('Ada Test'), not their ID, so with two people of the same name the link cannot be restored unambiguously
The Deals column in the people export: it was in the view, but not in people.csv
The currency of Deal value: the app shows '$', the export has the number only

friction.export_route: A menu item per view, 'Export view as CSV', gives a ZIP straight away: no support request and no waiting. Export through the API was not tested.
friction.format: Clean CSV files per object type (deals.csv with 10 columns, people.csv with 36) plus a separate notes.csv. Relations only as names, not as IDs; the Deals column is missing from the people export.
friction.reimport: Not tested: we did not re-import the export into folk or another CRM.
friction.cancellation: Not tested: this was a trial without a subscription.

exit_test.note: One export and re-import of synthetic records with known IDs, on the account and date stated. Friction is described, not scored; it is not a verdict on the product.
